instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium shot. In a sunny park with palm trees under a blue sky, the man in the black-and-white leaf-patterned shirt and sunglasses (R1) stands on the left next to the man in the black bowler hat and striped vest (R2) on the right. Both smile at the camera; the man (R1) gestures a shaka sign, while the man (R2) puts his arm around his shoulder and gestures with a gloved hand. Bright daylight fills the scene.
elements: R2 puts his arm around R1's shoulder
R1 gestures a shaka sign while R2 gestures with a gloved hand
R1 receives the shoulder contact from R2
R2 wears or uses a glove on the gesturing hand
sunny park with palm trees under a blue sky

questions.q: Does R2 put his arm around R1's shoulder, rather than R1 putting his arm around R2's shoulder?
questions.element: R2 initiates the shoulder contact on R1

questions.q: Is R1 the one making the shaka sign while R2 is the one placing an arm around R1's shoulder?
questions.element: R1 performs the shaka gesture while R2 performs the shoulder-contact role

questions.q: Does R2 gesture with a gloved hand while also being the person whose arm is around R1, rather than R1 being the gloved-hand shoulder-contact person?
questions.element: R2 combines the gloved-hand gesture with the arm-around-shoulder role

questions.q: Is R1 standing next to R2 while receiving R2's arm around his shoulder?
questions.element: R1 is the recipient of R2's shoulder contact

questions.q: Does R2 have a glove on the hand he gestures with?
